scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json && node scripts/copy-assets.mjs
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json
scripts.pack: npm run build && npm run stage && electron-builder --dir
scripts.dist: npm run build && npm run stage && electron-builder
